svg.title: Experience
svg.desc: Campus Ambassador, Northeastern University London, London, UK, Aug 2026 to now. Campus tours, open days and offer-holder events for prospective students and their families. Senior Analyst, IT Support, Capgemini, Noida, India, Jun 2023 to Dec 2025. Managed and prioritised 50+ incidents a day in ServiceNow, consistently meeting SLA targets. Built a Python tool that used an LLM to turn prose access requests into proposed Active Directory changes for my approval. It saved me 2 to 5 hours a week. Administered accounts, access permissions and endpoint compliance with Active Directory and Tanium. Associate, Technical Support, Tech Mahindra, Noida, India, Aug 2022 to Jun 2023. Support for Netgear and Orbi networking devices, with every case managed in Salesforce CRM. Associate, Customer Support, Tech Mahindra, India, Aug 2021 to May 2022. Customer support for the JioMart e-commerce platform in a high-volume contact centre.
